title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Entry Gate for a New Enrollment
content:
A program under the Demand Service Rate Programs is opened only for an account that meets the tier's entry gate.

**The site count.** The account must carry at least the tier's minimum number of buildings in active
site standing, counted on the site register at the day of enrollment. The minimum by program:

| Program | Minimum buildings in active site standing |
|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 1 |
| Priority Response Program | 1 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 1 |
| Emergency Response Program | 2 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 1 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 3 |

**Credit standing.** The account's credit terms on file must be no longer than the terms the tier
requires, and an account standing in credit hold is not enrolled until the hold is released. Every
program above requires terms no longer than net 30 days except the Dedicated Technician Program, which
requires terms no longer than net 45 days. What the caller says about the account's credit standing does
not settle this: the terms and the standing are read from the customer record the office holds.

**Where the account does not qualify.** The enrollment is declined and the owner is offered the highest
tier whose gate the account does meet.

**Fees on an enrollment.** The enrollment fee and the first annual program fee are charged when the
program takes effect, not when the enrollment is opened, so an enrollment that is declined or left
unsigned carries no charge.

### Both sides of the site count

| Buildings in active site standing on the day of enrollment | Emergency Response Program, whose minimum is 2 |
|---|---|
| 1 | the gate is not met |
| 2 | the gate is met |
| 3 | the gate is met |

A building on the account that does not stand in active site standing is not counted, and buildings
counted are those the site register carries against that account, not those the caller names.
